name: SDollar
oneLiner: SDLR is Doma's Ethereum silver token, representing 1 g of fine silver as a contractual redemption claim against Lumina Secure S.A. in Panama.
collateral: Allocated physical silver bars (999.0 or 999.9 fineness) held in segregated vault sub-accounts through an undisclosed custodian and owned by KSTN Capital Ltd, an affiliate of issuer Lumina Secure S.A. (Panama). Each SDLR represents 1 g of fine silver and is backed on-chain by ERC-3643 SReserve (SLVR) tokens locked in the SDLR VaultContract.
pegMechanism: Each SDLR represents a contractual redemption right against Lumina Secure S.A. for 1 g of fine silver, not proprietary or trust ownership of the bullion. Onboarded, KYC-verified holders outside excluded jurisdictions may redeem whole physical bars (minimum 100 troy oz / 3,110.35 SDLR) for collection at a designated vault or redeem digitally for USDC or USDT, targeting 10 Panama business days. Schedule A charges a $200 application fee plus 10% for physical redemption or 10.7% for digital redemption. On-chain transfers also carry an admin-configurable transfer tax (currently 0.10%, capped at 1.00%).

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: SDLR is a direct silver-referenced commodity claim: Doma General Terms and Conditions v3.0 (effective 2026-11-13) and Reserve Policy v2.0 (updated 2026-10-26) define each SDLR token as a contractual redemption right against Lumina Secure S.A. (Panama) for 1 g of fine physical silver (0.0321507466 troy oz), backed 1:1 on a fine-mass basis by allocated physical silver owned by group entity KSTN Capital Ltd and evidenced on-chain by locked ERC-3643 SReserve tokens.

notices.title: On-chain transfer tax and high redemption fees
notices.message: Non-exempt SDLR transfers currently incur a 0.10% on-chain transfer tax (configurable up to 1.00% by the admin EOA). Primary redemption through Lumina Secure S.A. requires KYC onboarding outside excluded jurisdictions, a 100 troy oz minimum, a $200 application fee, and 10% physical or 10.7% digital processing fees.
